New listing (published November 23, 2026)

Igarashi Sake Brewery's annual New Sake Festival will be held.

日時 (Date and time): Saturday, December 5, 2026 (Reiwa 8), 10:00 AM – 3:00 PM
会場 (Venue): Igarashi Sake Brewery, 667-1 Kawaji, Hanno, Saitama Prefecture

Shuttle buses run regularly from the south exit of Hanno Station.

Event highlights:
• Limited-edition new sake for sale
• Free sake tasting (one taste per person)
• Free amazake (sweet rice drink)
• Sake bar
• Multiple food and drink stalls

More information: https://hanno-tourism.jp/news/%e4%ba%94%e5%8d%81%e5%b5%90%e9%85%92%e9%80%a0%e3%80%80%e6%96%b0%e9%85%92%e7%a5%ad%e3%82%8a12-5%e9%96%8b%e5%82%ac%ef%bc%81
